1027. Multi-Base Number Converter

40

Medium

Problem Statement:
Design and develop a number converter that performs the decimal number into binary, octal, and hexadecimal numbers using user-defined functions and vice-versa.
input_spec:
The first line of the space-separated integer input consists of choices C1 and C2 indicating the conversion units from a given unit to a required unit.

Below are the choices that are available:

1- Decimal

2- Binary

3- Octal

4- Hexadecimal

The second line of the input consists of a single input value X(a C1 number) which need to be converted to a C2 number
output_spec: The output consists of a single value indicating the converted C2 number of the given input X
